generationInputs.prompt: A vector illustration against a bright white background displays four parallel decorative borders rendered in flat, solid black lines. The topmost border features a repeating pattern of small, stylized elements: roses, other flowers, leaves, hearts, dots, and two miniature elephants with upward-curving trunks. The second border shows a delicate, wavy vine with small, round berries and pointed leaves. The third border is more structured, with a series of circles connected by a thin, wavy line. Each circle contains a different symbol: a snowflake, a five-pointed star, a leaf, a solid heart, and a crown. Small, leafy sprigs and five-pointed stars extend from the wavy line. The bottommost border presents a flowing, curvilinear line adorned with clusters of circles and dots of various sizes, small hearts, and curled flourishes.
